Please arrive on time so you can enjoy the full experience. Due to time constraints, we are unable to seat guests who arrive after 6:15PM. Share Share Link Close share Copy link View full details Collapsible content Purchase Policy Due to the nature of the events, no refunds or credits will be given if the Participant is unable to attend. However, tickets can be transferred to someone else. Please contact us at reservations@outstandinginthefield.com with the new guest’s information at least 24 hours prior to the event, or tell the guests using your reservation to give your name at arrival. Transferring funds for your tickets is your responsibility. In the case of an event being postponed due to circumstances beyond Outstanding in the Field’s control, Outstanding in the Field will reschedule said event and all purchases will be honored for the rescheduled future event date. To view our full purchase policy please visit: Terms of Purchase Dietary Information Due to the family style nature of our meals and in order to uphold the highest quality standards, we can only guarantee accommodations for vegetarian requests.
